prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Confirm Desktop Visibility", "Ensure your desktop pet overlay is visible on screen before proceeding.", "Pet Is Visible"]
2: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Meet your interactive companion that lives directly on your desktop screen.", "Choose your journey to get started with your new pet."]
3: ["Upload Pet Photo", "Clear lighting and face visibility", "Tips for Custom Pet Photos", "For best custom rendering, use bright lighting and clear front-facing angles.", "Got It, Continue"]
4: ["Your pet is being prepared for your desktop screen."]
5: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Log into your account to sync your companion state securely.", "Use the same account credentials every time to retain your pet save."]
6: ["Right-click pet on desktop for options; press shortcut keys to show/hide.", "Controls Quick Guide: Right-click pet to hide or chat."]
7: ["Adoption Certificate Ready!", "Your companion adoption includes a free bonus desktop toy item!", "Free Starter Accessory Unlocked"]
8: ["We'll notify your desktop when your pet is ready to play."]
9: ["Choose Your Companion Path", "Select how you would like to begin."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and bonus items
